title: Goo Cursor
description: A slime that follows the cursor: blobs with surface tension, courtesy of an SVG goo filter.
usage: Six blobs chase the pointer in a chain, each lazier than the last, and a blur-and-contrast filter fuses them into one creature with surface tension. It serves no purpose a meeting could survive. It is also the first thing everyone touches — some parts exist to be played with.
a11y: Pointer theatre in its purest form: invisible to assistive technology, absent on touch, and fully still under prefers-reduced-motion. The stage beneath it must carry its own meaning, because the goo carries none.
